Organizations think they need "numbers" people. But they really need financial strategists and someone who can communicate to the rest of the organization. With an Accounting degree from Lewis University, students are prepared to be both.

In this degree, students will learn:

  • Practical, hands-on skills they will use on the job
  • How to record and interpret essential financial data for effective decision making
  • Today's current accounting procedures and laws
  • Ethical framework for accounting practices

Accounting majors have a wide and varied selection of jobs from which to choose. Auditing is one of the best-known services provided. Public accounting firms provide most auditing services to public companies. Public accounting firms may also provide tax advice and information system services. Accountants take positions in business or industry as financial officers, controllers, internal auditors, and staff accountants. Other jobs include financial advisers for governmental and other not-for-profit organizations and personal financial planners.

Success requires commitment to service, strong communication skills, problem solving ability, and the ability to work in a team.

Aviation Maintenance is what Lewis University was founded on in 1932, and now it is more important than ever. With Boeing’s latest projection, the world will need 679,000 maintenance technicians by 2035. Students who graduate with a degree in Aviation Maintenance are prepared to work in the world’s fastest growing field.

This program will prepare students to secure both ratings required to be a licensed Aviation Maintenance Technician (AMT).

Powerplant Rating

This rating will enable students to work on aircraft engines.

Airframe Rating

This rating will allow students to work on the body of the airplane outside the engine; including wings, wheels, brakes, etc.

Lewis University Maintenance Certificate courses are approved by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), under Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations, Part 147, and are continuously updated.

Students will be prepared for technical management positions with airlines or maintenance, repair and operations (MRO) facilities, including:

  • Aviation Maintenance Technician
  • Flight Operator
  • Crew Scheduler
  • Aircraft Maintenance Director
  • Aircraft Maintenance Supervisor
  • Airline marketing professionals
  • Aircraft parts sales

Note: Lewis University has combined BS Aviation and Aerospace Technology program with their BS Aviation Maintenance Technology Program.

The Bachelor of Science in Business Analytics degree will provide students with the perfect mix of business strategy and technological expertise required for informed decision-making in any organization.

Lewis' business analytics degree curriculum combines technical knowledge with managerial theory - providing students with a deep foundational understanding of topics such as business intelligence, data analysis, business data modeling, predictive modeling and business data warehousing - preparing them for a wide variety of career options.

In this course, students will:

  • Gain a working knowledge of data analysis tools for business decision making
  • Have hands-on experience for processing and analysis of data in business disciplines such as financial portfolio management, supply-chain optimization, healthcare informatics, and social media marketing
  • Develop critical thinking and problem solving skills through project simulations
  • Learn to professionally communicate analysis results with any future employer
  • Learn from expert faculty who bring a wide range of business analytics experience to the classroom
  • Learn how to manage and organize data, people and systems
6ada:
The Lewis University program in Computer Engineering is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET. From microprocessors to embedded computing devices, laptops to supercomputers, students will gain the expertise necessary to help invent the next generation of computing.

Lewis' state-of-the-art undergraduate lab resources and supportive educational community provide the perfect learning environment to become a successful Computer Engineer. In this interdisciplinary curriculum that combines math, computer science, physics and electrical engineering, students will become an expert in:

  • How microprocessors function, are designed and are optimized
  • How integrated systems of electrical components are designed and how data is communicated among them to process instructions
  • How software is written, compiled and optimized for specific hardware platforms
  • The boundaries of physics and how to push them in order to develop the next generation of computing devices

Program Objectives

  • Excel in a career that utilizes their undergraduate computer engineering education.
  • Demonstrate ethical and professional integrity in their professional and personal interactions.
  • Keep up-to-date with rapidly evolving technologies related to computing and/or engineering and continually pursue professional development.
  • Informed by their liberal arts education, seek and pursue opportunities to identify, understand, and address challenges in a broad range of disciplines.
  • Be distinguished as creative developers of innovative solutions in their professional roles.

Lewis University’s Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence (MSAI) degree is designed to provide students with an advanced education in one of today’s most high-demand fields: artificial intelligence (AI). It equips them with the skills necessary to contribute to the rapidly evolving AI landscape. Graduates will be capable of designing AI-based systems and leading AI-driven projects across various industries.

The Artificial Intelligence master’s degree program equips students with the in-depth knowledge and practical skills needed to build and implement modern AI systems. The program provides the necessary theoretical background in machine learning and artificial intelligence, knowledge related to the application of AI in computing systems, and an understanding of the ethical implications in the development and use of artificial intelligence. Graduates will be prepared for a wide range of careers where artificial intelligence is applied, including positions in industry or government, or for further graduate studies.

More and more organizations are looking for data-driven decision makers - those with a master’s degree in business analytics who have the educational qualifications to make strategic, operations, marketing and healthcare decisions based on objective and rock-solid data driven business intelligence.

Everyone is talking about “big data”. But there aren’t nearly enough qualified individuals ready to help organizations analyze and leverage data intelligence for improved decision making. This Master’s in Business Analytics from Lewis University will prepare students to do just that and enter one of the fastest-growing careers around.

Students will attain a working knowledge of how to use data intelligence tools for informed and objective decision making. Through an interdisciplinary curriculum they will:

  • Get real-world and hands-on experience with state-of-the-art data mining and business intelligence tools and technologies
  • Gain the quantitative and data analysis skills required to solve complex business problems
  • Learn how to develop corporate strategy by exploring relationships in an organization’s "big data" and predictive decision modeling.
  • Learn how to analyze large data sets to uncover hidden relationships and make more informed business decisions
  • Gain a working knowledge of data analysis techniques such as decision trees, classification, clustering, segmentation, decision support systems, search algorithms, data mining, factor and discriminant analysis and optimization concepts for data

Financial Analytics

Combining fundamental analytics theory with the abundant data available in financial markets, financial analysts can help solve quantitative problems ranging from maximizing stock price to determining optimal portfolios.

An MBA degree from Lewis University prepares graduates to stand out from the competition, to take charge, and to make change. In the highly competitive global marketplace, a master’s degree in business sets students apart from other job candidates. Whether students are looking to change careers or advance within their own company, a business master’s degree will give them the knowledge and the skills to take ownership of their own career trajectory.

This MBA program is accredited by the Accreditation Council for Business Schools and Programs (ACBSP), with an emphasis on teaching and applied knowledge. The ACBSP focuses on tangible learning outcomes and quality improvement, especially as workforce demands change.

Upon successful completion of a micro-credential, students will receive a digital badge from the Lewis University Graduate School of Management. Micro-credentials offer immediate value to current employers and demonstrate mastery of in-demand business skills to potential future employers. Students will also have their micro-credentials posted to their transcript upon completion of their MBA program.
